views.name: user_balance_summary
views.definition:
SELECT id AS user_id,
    points AS balance,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(pl.amount) AS sum
           FROM points_ledger pl
          WHERE pl.user_id = p.id AND pl.amount > 0), 0::bigint)::integer AS total_earned,
    COALESCE(( SELECT sum(rr.points_requested) AS sum
           FROM redemption_requests rr
          WHERE rr.user_id = p.id AND rr.status = 'pending'::text), 0::bigint)::integer AS pending_withdrawal,
    (points - COALESCE(( SELECT sum(rr.points_requested) AS sum
           FROM redemption_requests rr
          WHERE rr.user_id = p.id AND rr.status = 'pending'::text), 0::bigint))::integer AS available_to_withdraw
   FROM profiles p;

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created AFTER INSERT ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION handle_new_user()
CREATE TRIGGER notify_submission_status AFTER UPDATE OF status ON public.task_submissions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION notify_submission_status_change()
CREATE TRIGGER notify_redemption_status AFTER UPDATE OF status ON public.redemption_requests FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION notify_redemption_status_change()
CREATE TRIGGER sync_survey_answers_from_proof BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF proof, survey_answers ON public.task_submissions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_survey_answers_from_proof()
CREATE TRIGGER protect_notification_user_update BEFORE UPDATE ON public.notifications FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.protect_notification_user_update()
CREATE TRIGGER protect_task_submission_user_update BEFORE UPDATE ON public.task_submissions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.protect_task_submission_user_update()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, name)
  values (new.id, coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'name', ''));
  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: notify_redemption_status_change
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_redemption_status_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$ begin if old.status is distinct from new.status then insert into public.notifications(user_id,title,message,type) values (new.user_id, case when new.status='approved' then 'Reward approved' when new.status='paid' then 'Reward paid' when new.status='rejected' then 'Reward rejected' else 'Redemption updated' end, case when new.status='approved' then 'Your reward request was approved.' when new.status='paid' then 'Your reward has been marked as paid.' when new.status='rejected' then 'Your reward request was rejected.' else 'Your redemption status changed.' end,'redemption'); end if; return new; end; $function$

notify_submission_status_change
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_submission_status_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF old.status IS DISTINCT FROM new.status THEN
    INSERT INTO public.notifications(user_id,title,message,type)
    VALUES (
      new.user_id,
      CASE WHEN new.status='approved' THEN 'Task approved' WHEN new.status='rejected' THEN 'Task rejected' ELSE 'Submission updated' END,
      CASE WHEN new.status='approved' THEN 'Your task submission was approved. You can now request your reward.' WHEN new.status='rejected' THEN 'Your task submission was rejected.' ELSE 'Your task submission status changed.' END,
      'submission'
    );
  END IF;
  RETURN new;
END;
$function$

functions.name: is_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles
    where id = (select auth.uid())
      and role = 'admin'
  );
$function$
